svg.title: A traffic route follows the old map line that crosses a pond.
svg.desc: Riju overlays land, drainage, and traffic maps. The straight road that crosses open water becomes an all-season traffic route, although the blocked physical drains remain visible behind the sheets.
svg.text: Page 40, panel 3 · Overhead comparison of drainage, land and traffic map layers

text.tspan: Riju identifies the route as a reused land-map
